subject: Observability add-ons: crediting model and dashboard access
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing pricing questions

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the demo last week. A couple of follow-ups from our tech and procurement teams as we map out an internal budget:

- We are targeting a 90-day retention window across traces and metrics for our core patient-facing services.
- Want to understand options for "seatless" access to advanced dashboards (our platform team prefers not to buy per-seat licenses).
- Curious about tracing sampling: can you provide sizing guidance and an example cost comparison between sampling at 1% vs 10% for a ~50M requests/month workload?
- Procurement asked whether you can credit unused retention storage against token/ingestion overages or if those are separate line items.

If you have a short pricing/packaging note or a spreadsheet that outlines a few common permutations, that would be super helpful. Also attaching our procurement timeline (we have an internal Q3 budget review).

Cheers,
Elaine
Elaine Park
Director, Platform Engineering — Acme Health

Attachment: Acme-reqs-Q3-timeline.pdf (1 page, PDF)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing pricing questions

Hi Elaine —

Great to hear from you and thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and a proposed next step:

1) Retention models: we support three common approaches — per-GB metered retention, slab/credit bundles (X TB included, then per-GB), and a hybrid where you prepay credits that can be consumed by metrics/logs/traces. For 90-day retention at your scale our ops team usually recommends a slab+burst-credit model to avoid large month-to-month bill variability.

2) Seatless dashboards: we can offer a tenant-level dashboard license (single tenant license + concurrent viewer caps) instead of per-seat seats. That maps to a single line item and avoids seat management.

3) Tracing sampling example: I ran a quick ballpark — for 50M requests/month, at 1% sampled traces you’re looking at ~500k traces/month; at 10% ~5M traces. Cost delta is largely driven by retention and index choices. I attached a short pricing breakdown with sample permutations.

4) Crediting unused retention: we can structure credits (prepaid retention credits) that apply to any telemetry ingestion; they do not automatically offset token-generation charges (text generation) but can offset other ingestion-based add-ons. We can discuss an exception for bundled Enterprise deals.

I’ve looped in Ben from Commercial to propose an initial commercial construct; Ben — I attached a very light pricing sheet (pricing-breakdown-3pagers.pdf) and Acme’s timeline. Would you want to propose a starter pilot (90 days, $10k in retention credits) plus an introductory discount on the first-year add-on list?

If agreeable we can set a 30-minute call Thursday to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing-breakdown-3pagers.pdf (3 pages, PDF)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmehealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Observability add-ons — pilot & commercial framing

Hi Elaine —

Thanks Mina. Following up with a concrete commercial framing based on your ask and Mina’s guidance:

Option A (Pilot-first, low-friction)
- 90-day pilot
- $10k prepaid retention credits (usable across metrics/logs/traces)
- Tenant-level dashboard enablement (seatless) for the pilot period
- No charge for tracing beyond sampling at 1% during pilot

Option B (Commit + Sizing)
- Annual commit covering baseline retention + dashboards
- Introductory add-on discount: 25% off list for year 1 for retention + tracing + dashboards
- Surge protection: standard surge surcharge applies; we can waive the first quarter surcharge on a 12-month commit
- SLA: 99.9% availability for the dashboards; enhanced support add-on available

A few notes on packaging: we recommend bundling dashboards as a single tenant license (flat line item) and handling retention via slab credits so you get predictable unit economics. For large commits we can negotiate deeper discounts and a custom revenue-crediting clause that lets you move unused retention credits across projects.

Next steps: I’ll draft an SOW + pilot acceptance criteria (delivery timeline, success metrics) and send for signature. Can you confirm procurement windows (Elaine cc’d procurement) and whether both pilot and a 1-year commit option are acceptable to present to finance?

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW-Acme-Observability-v1.pdf (draft)

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — pilot & commercial framing

Ben / Mina —

Thanks for the clear options — good to see both a low-friction pilot and a commit pathway. A couple of procurement asks before we can greenlight:

- Procurement would like the first-quarter surge surcharge waived for the pilot and the first paid quarter on the commit path.
- We need a SOC 2 evidence matrix and a short mapping doc for required controls for hosted telemetry ingestion (our security team will review).
- For the pilot acceptance criteria: can you include an upper bound on trace ingestion for the pilot (we prefer a hard cap so finance can budget for overages)?

If those three items are included in the SOW we can run the pilot approval through our procurement meeting next Tuesday. Happy to sign the pilot SOW once those items are baked in.

Best,
Elaine

Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — pilot & commercial framing (next steps)

Quick summary and proposed commitments to include in the SOW (copying Elaine for confirmation):

1) Pilot: 90 days, $10k prepaid retention credits, tenant-level dashboard enabled (seatless). Cap traces during pilot at 6M traces total (equivalent to ~12% sampling at peak). Any ingestion over that cap billed at standard overage rates.

2) Introductory commercial concession on annual commit: 25% off add-on list for year 1 (retention + tracing + dashboards) if customer signs a 12-month commit within 60 days after pilot completion.

3) Surge surcharge: waive the first-quarter surge surcharge for both the pilot and the first paid quarter on the commit path.

4) Security evidence: attach SOC2 evidence matrix and mapping doc to the SOW (SOC2-evidence-matrix.xlsx). We’ll also include a short controls mapping for telemetry ingestion.

5) Deliverables & next steps: Ben to circulate the SOW draft with acceptance criteria and the DocuSign link by end of day Monday. Mina to schedule a 30-minute procurement handoff call for Tuesday 10AM PT.

If that looks good to Acme, we’ll finalize the SOW and get procurement to sign. Elaine — please confirm the trace cap and the 25% concession so we can lock these into the SOW.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
